releaseNotes: Chromecast support adds a Cast button for Chromecast, Google TV, Nest speakers and displays, and compatible Google Cast receivers on the same Wi-Fi network. LocalWave transfers the active queue, position, playback state, controls, metadata, and artwork between the phone and receiver. Local music stays on the phone and is served only through a temporary authenticated same-Wi-Fi stream; it is not uploaded to a LocalWave cloud. Listening Statistics follow actual remote playback without double-counting route handoff. Google Play services are required, and audio-format support depends on the receiver because this release does not transcode files.
